'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Scott Lingrell DS Coruscant: ISB Central Office (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
